AO No. 239 of 2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. B.S. Bisht, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. D.S. Patni, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Issue notices to the respondents 
calling their objections (if any) against 
the delay condonation application 
(CLMA No.4388 of 2016). 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Call the LCR. 
List in due course after service. 
If the appellant deposits rupees 
fifteen lakh, out of the total awarded 
amount, adjusting compulsory 
statutory amount, within six weeks 
from today before the Tribunal 
concerned, recovery in pursuance of 
the impugned judgment shall remain 
stayed till further orders of this Court. 
Stay application (CLMA 
No.4389 of 2016) stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 
 11.05.2016 Nadim

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rajiv Sharma,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Singh,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
AO No. 239 of 2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. B.S. Bisht, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. D.S. Patni, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Sumit Bajaj, Advocate for the 
respondent nos. 1 and 2. 
This appeal has been filed with 
the delay of only eleven days, which has 
not seriously been opposed. More so, 
where-against, no written objection has 
been filed, hence, such delay is hereby 
condoned. Delay condonation application 
(CLMA 4388/2016) is accordingly 
allowed. 
Appeal is admitted for hearing. 
Rupees eight lakh be reimbursed 
to the claimants/respondent nos.1 and 2 
without asking any surety or security 
from them in this regard. 
Rest of the amount be invested in 
the form of TDR for at least three years 
with some local hill bank. 
Money withdrawal application 
(CLMA 6777/2016) stands disposed of. 
List in due course for final 
hearing. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 
 11.07.2016 Nadim
